    • addPlayer

      public boolean addPlayer(VirtualClient c) throws IllegalStateException, IOException
      Attempts to add a new client to the match, checking if he was already in the match. If the match reaches its target capacity with this new player, the game will start automatically!
      Overrides:
      addPlayer in class Match
      Parameters:
      c - the client trying to join
      Returns:
      true only if the player was connected before server crashed.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the match is full or has already started
      IOException - if there is an issue establishing the initial game model for the clients
